h: Sina Rambo's estranged wife responds to fresh reports of trouble in their marriage
p: Heidi Korth has publicly responded after new reports of a crisis in her marriage to singer Sina Rambo. The singer has not been widely reported to have commented.
more: The couple's situation is drawing wide discussion online.
